name: Onna Souryo Layla ~Mamono Sukuu Ryoujoku no Doukutsu~
original_name: 女僧侶レイラ　～まもの巣食う陵辱の洞窟～
source:
This CG novel adventure game with decision branches features a priestess named Layla in a cave full of traps and perverted monsters who violate her in scenes full of shame and seductive depravity. The monsters are lying in wait to ravage Layla.

Depending on the scene, you can change her clothing to a priest's garb, a revealing swimsuit, tights only, and apron only. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036125.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这款带有决策分支的CG小说冒险游戏的主角是一位名叫莱拉的女祭司，她身处一个充满陷阱的洞穴中，还有一些变态的怪物在充满羞耻和诱惑的堕落场景中侵犯她。怪物们正埋伏着，伺机蹂躏莱拉。

根据场景的不同，你可以将她的衣服换成牧师的服装、暴露的泳衣、紧身衣和围裙。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036125.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
